XPLORIO.TITLE: Xplorio
XPLORIO.OPEN_DOC: Xplorio runs on its own port: {url}
XPLORIO.SECTION_SETTINGS_DOC: After saving, Xplorio restarts; reload it once in the browser.
XPLORIO.PORT_DOC: Port of the Xplorio web server (default 4040). Bookmarks and home screen icons use this address.
XPLORIO.TAG_SERVICE_DOC: Needed for the tag editor, library check, history, Discover and mood mix.
XPLORIO.LANGUAGE_DOC: Language of the interface. Automatic = as set in Volumio.
XPLORIO.THEME_DOC: Light, dark or like the device (kioskTV stays dark).
XPLORIO.SECTION_FEATURES_DOC: Switch individual features on or off.
XPLORIO.HISTORY_DOC: The tag service records played tracks (history, statistics, Discover).
XPLORIO.RELEASEDATES_DOC: Look up missing album release dates on MusicBrainz (album birthdays).
XPLORIO.MOODTAGS_DOC: Collect Last.fm tags per track, only while nothing is playing (needs the Last.fm access).
XPLORIO.COLOR_MOOD_DOC: Color mood from the cover (only covers from the player itself).
XPLORIO.M4A_PROBE_DOC: For m4a files, read the codec (ALAC or AAC) from the file.
XPLORIO.M4A_LOSSLESS_DOC: Classify m4a without a detected codec as lossless (ALAC). Off = no badge for m4a.
XPLORIO.TIDAL_DOC: TIDAL parts (choice in the search, similar artists). Automatic = only if the TIDAL plugin is active.
XPLORIO.QOBUZ_DOC: Like TIDAL, for the Qobuz plugin.
XPLORIO.SPOTIFY_DOC: Like TIDAL, for Volumio's Spotify plugin with search (needs Premium).
XPLORIO.ALLOWED_HOSTS_DOC: The tag service and the Rotel bridge only answer on IP addresses and names like player.local. Add further names here, separated by commas, e.g. player.example.net.
XPLORIO.SECTION_ROTEL_DOC: Power and volume of a Rotel amplifier on the network.
XPLORIO.ROTEL_BRIDGE_DOC: On/off button at the top left, volume on the amplifier, remote control on the playback page.
XPLORIO.ROTEL_HOST_DOC: IP address or name of the amplifier on the network, e.g. 192.168.1.50.
XPLORIO.ROTEL_INPUTS_DOC: Optional, separated by commas: input=name, optionally with an icon, e.g. aux=Turntable/phono, opt1=TV. Icons: phono, cd, tuner, bluetooth, usb, digital, aux, pc, tv.
XPLORIO.ROTEL_NO_HOST: Please enter the amplifier address for the Rotel bridge.
XPLORIO.SECTION_LASTFM_DOC: For similar artists, lyrics, cover search, mood tags and scrobbling.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_KEY_DOC: From https://www.last.fm/api/accounts. Stays on the player and is not shown again; leave empty to keep the saved one.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_SECRET_DOC: Only needed for scrobbling. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_CLEAR_DOC: Removes key and secret from the player when saving.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_BAD: The Last.fm key or secret contains invalid characters (letters and digits only).
XPLORIO.LASTFM_FAIL: The Last.fm access could not be saved: {error}
XPLORIO.SECTION_SYSTEM_DOC: Protection of the "System" page and write permissions of the tag editor.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_DOC: Protects restarting and stopping services in Xplorio (Volumio itself stays open). At least 4 characters; a new password logs out all devices. Leave empty to keep the current one. Forgotten: sudo xplorio-deploy --password on the player.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_NONE: No password set yet, the buttons stay locked.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_SHORT: The password needs at least 4 characters.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_FAIL: The password could not be saved: {error}
XPLORIO.TAGS_ROOT_DOC: Only needed if the tag editor fails for lack of write permission. Tags and embedded covers are then written by a protected script with root rights, only below /mnt and /media.
XPLORIO.TAGS_RW: All music folders are writable for Volumio, the switch is not needed.
XPLORIO.TAGS_NOSUDO: The permission for this is missing: reinstall the plugin once.
XPLORIO.BAD_PORT: Please enter a port between 1024 and 65535 (not 3000).
XPLORIO.BAD_HOST: The amplifier address contains invalid characters.
XPLORIO.BAD_HOSTS: The names contain invalid characters (letters, digits, dot and hyphen only, separated by commas).
XPLORIO.BAD_INPUTS: Please enter the inputs like this: aux=Turntable/phono, opt1=TV (icon optional).
XPLORIO.SYSTEMD: {name} runs as a system service (systemd), the plugin leaves it as it is.
XPLORIO.PORT_BUSY: Port {port} is in use: the Xplorio web server could not start.
XPLORIO.OWN_BROKEN: /data/xplorio/config.local.js contains an error and is left out.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_WRONG: The current password is wrong, nothing changed.
XPLORIO.PASSWORD_LOCKED: Too many wrong attempts, please wait {wait} s.
